'''Barkhesh''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] located in the [[Seitia sector/Legends|Seitia sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].

==Description==
[[File:Barkhesh_1.jpg|thumb|left|The landscape of Barkhesh was typically lush and green.]]
Barkhesh was a lush [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] [[Agriworld/Legends|agriworld]].<ref name="SoR" />

On the planet was sold an indigenous microbe-based [[Insect Culture|Barkhesh Insect Culture]] which was deadly to insects and used as bug repellent by scouts. [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] environmentalists decried the Culture.<ref name="AJ6">{{JournalCite|6|Scouts' Dispatch}}</ref><ref name="GFTPG">''[[Gundark's Fantastic Technology: Personal Gear]]''</ref>

==History==
Barkhesh was the [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of [[Judicial Forces/Legends|Judicial Forces]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] [[Antidar Williams/Legends|Antidar Williams]].<ref name="DB" />

During the time of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], Barkhesh's population [[Barkhesh Resistance|resisted]] the [[New Order/Legends|New Order]] and supported the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]]. They supplied the Alliance with vital materials after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] despite Imperial retaliation.<ref name="SoR" />

[[File:Barkhesh_Xwings.jpg|thumb|left|250px|[[Rogue Squadron/Legends|Rogue Squadron]] over Barkhesh]]
According to [[Imperial Army/Legends|Imperial Army]] [[High General]] [[Cassio Tagge/Legends|Cassio Tagge]], as documented in the ''[[Imperial Handbook: A Commander's Guide]]'', the [[1st Tapani Assault Battlegroup]] claimed victory in the [[Humiliation of Barkhesh]] sometime before the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]]. However, [[General/Legends|General]] [[Carlist Rieekan/Legends|Carlist Rieekan]] of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] later refuted Tagge after the text fell into Rebel hands, claiming the 1st Tapani withdrew from Barkhesh after losing a fifth of its [[Trooper/Legends|troopers]] in an [[Acid rain/Legends|acidic hailstorm]].<ref name="Imperial Handbook">''[[Star Wars: Imperial Handbook: A Commander's Guide]]''</ref>

Around [[0 ABY/Legends|six months]] after the pivotal [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], the Rebel's [[Rogue Squadron/Legends|Rogue Squadron]] provided aerial cover for a small supply [[Convoy/Legends|convoy]] on the planet's surface, which planned to travel through Imperial territory in the [[Great Temple Valley]] to rendezvous with a Rebel Alliance shuttle. The [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire]] caught wind of the operation, and sent a reasonably large force of [[All Terrain Scout Transport/Legends|AT-ST]] walkers and [[TIE/sa tactical bomber/Legends|TIE/sa bombers]] to intercept the convoy of transports. Rogue Squadron successfully [[Rendezvous on Barkhesh|protected]] the convoy, destroying a large portion of the forces. After escaping the Imperial forces, the convoy rendezvoused with a Rebel Alliance [[Lambda-class T-4a shuttle/Legends|Lambda-class T-4a shuttle]].<ref name="SW:RS" />

{{Planet-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Barkhesh appears in the [[1998]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] [[Star Wars: Rogue Squadron (video game)|''Star Wars: Rogue Squadron'']].
